description: Roma Tre University publishes the HISMACITY pro dataset framework for planning in small European municipalities. The repository describes geographic and local data combined into indicators for historic-town quality, land use and demographic change. Weighted suitability calculations allow planners to vary indicator inputs and linear-combination weights. The named Zenodo record provides a RAR package and explicitly states CC BY 4.0, permitting free reuse; the article states a different, more restrictive dataset licence, so that discrepancy remains recorded. The material can inform urban-planning scenario inputs and indicator definitions. Its short repository description does not establish a standalone executable simulator or specify complete place and time coverage. Archive contents and calculations were not tested. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
